body_lead: Kerala High Court to launch Unique Neutral Citation, AI tool for English-Malayalam translation of district court judgments/ documents The High Court will launch SUVAS, an Al tool for translating judgements/orders of the District Courts from English to Malayalam as well as for translating vernacular judgements/documents of District Courts into English.
